turns.prompt_text: does baking soda go well with steel?
turns.response_html:
Yes, baking soda is excellent for cleaning and polishing stainless steel. Its mild abrasiveness removes stains and grime without scratching the surface.

Common Uses

  • Removing Burnt Food: Create a paste with water, apply it to the affected area, and let it sit for 15–20 minutes before scrubbing.
  • Polishing: Sprinkle dry powder on a damp cloth to buff out water spots and restore shine.
  • Deodorizing: It neutralizes odors in steel containers or sinks.

Always scrub in the direction of the metal grain to prevent micro-scratches and ensure a uniform finish.
